subject: Return only the relevant bit in sdsGetAuxBit() (#2048)
reason: The change masks sdsGetAuxBit()'s return value to a single bit (`& 1U`), but it is purely defensive hardening with no observable behaviour change: the only caller is the hash entry encoding in t_hash.c, which uses only aux bit 0, and the embedded field's flags byte is always written by sdswrite() as exactly the SDS type, so aux bits 1-4 are always zero on both builds. The sole reader, entryHasValuePtr(), additionally returns bool, so even a multi-bit value would have the same truthiness. Both builds compute identical results on every reachable path, so no command sequence, fault, or persistenc
